title: How to convert times between time zones
task: Shift timestamps by a UTC offset — server logs to local time, meeting times across offices.

excel.note: A2 = datetime, B2 = offset in hours (e.g. -7 for UTC→Pacific in summer).

explanation: Times are day-fractions, so hours divide by 24: adding −7/24 turns 02:30 UTC on July 27 into 19:30 on July 26 — the date rolls back automatically because datetimes are one number. Keep the offset in its own cell so DST changes are one edit, not a formula hunt. The honest limitation: spreadsheets have no time-zone database — the formula applies the offset YOU supply; it can't know when Denver switches to daylight time. For always-correct conversion across DST boundaries you need the source data stamped in UTC plus a rules table.
